# Aesthedes C100/0038, 68000 CPU

This card contains a 68000 CPU clocked at 8 MHz, 1MB RAM, possibly 256K ROM, and four 6822 PIAs.

It has a DIN 61412 2x32 backplane connector for a G-64 bus.

<!-- $Begin-Autogenerated$ FeaturedPic aes_68k -->
[![Aesthedes C100-0038 card](https://www.egueli.com/aesthedes/thumbs/cards/616_AesC100-0038_SN1964/IMG_20260220_172911.jpg)](https://www.egueli.com/aesthedes/pics/cards/616_AesC100-0038_SN1964/IMG_20260220_172911.jpg)

Aesthedes C100-0038 card


<!-- $End-Autogenerated$ -->

The first ROM bank is mapped at 0x800000, with the first 8 byte also readable at 0x000000 for processor bootup, and the RAM is from 0x000000 to 0x0fffff.

The four ports have a similar architecture as in [the I/O VME card](../aes_io/README.md).

## Slot 616

SN: 1964

Connections:

	A: to 516C
	B, C, D: unplugged
